chunks: As for the one who said, 'Abu Muhammad (peace be upon him) had no son,'
his statement is invalidated by what we have proven regarding the Imamate of the Twelve, and the bestowal of authority upon them.

key_terms.أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ: Abu Muhammad (title of Imam Hasan al-Askari)

ai.seo_question: How does Shia theology refute the claim that Imam Hasan al-Askari had no son?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi grounds the refutation of the Waqifiyya and others who denied Imam Hasan al-Askari's offspring in the immutable doctrine of the Twelve Imams (Ithna 'Ashariyya), where the specific designation of each Imam serves as proof for the next. By linking the continuity of Wilayah to the physical lineage of the twelfth Imam, he establishes that the denial of his son is tantamount to denying the divinely ordained structure of the Imamate itself.
